title: How to Find Strong Summary Coherence Measures? A Toolbox and a Comparative Study for Summary Coherence Measure Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Introducing 'bias matrices' to analyze the ranking accuracy of coherence measures on consistent versus inverted pairs of summaries, identifying if an evaluation metric unfairly prefers outputs from a specific summarization system (e.g., BART) over others regardless of actual human coherence scores.

Evaluating automatic coherence measures against artificial confounders (such as capitalization rates and system architecture markers) to determine if the metrics are exploiting superficial system-level heuristics rather than genuinely modeling text coherence.
